title: Quantizer
text: Discretize input at given interval, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Interval between samples; {Quantization interval} sets the interval that defines quantization levels for the output and {Treat as gain when linearizing} sets the gain value. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Input signal to quantize scalar | vector

params.name: Quantization interval
params.values: Interval that defines quantization levels for the output signal 0.5 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Treat as gain when linearizing
params.values: Specify the gain value on (default) | off
